APP01 and private client · your migration notes
Record the Server 2019 version, PHP/osTicket/MariaDB versions, help desk URL, ticket ID,
attachment test, certificate expiry, backup path and database size.
Follow the existing Azure migration lessons to move the VMware workload to a supported private
Azure network and validate it before the Server 2022 upgrade. Use a supported migration/upgrade
procedure for the exact VM and OS; keep rollback available.
At cutover, point the PRIVATE helpdesk.lab.example.test A record at the validated Azure private
address reachable from your lab/client network. Do not edit a guest’s static IP as though it
were an Azure NIC setting. Re-test HTTPS, login, a ticket, attachment, mail and backup.
Check: A documented baseline exists for migration, with separate checks for cutover and later
